concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-payto-android-component]] — 2026-09-15-captured PayTo Android Components Sessions/Advanced guide for one-time and subscription mandates, bank approval, tokens, subsequent charges and asynchronous webhooks; source flags token-reference ambiguity and example syntax.
warnings: Guide names recurringDetailReference in RECURRING_CONTRACT prose, pspReference in its webhook section, and data.storedPaymentMethodId in recurring.token.created for later charges; preserve each source-specific reference without assuming interchangeability.
Several request JSON examples omit a comma after shopperReference and response examples are rendered as curl requests; do not present them as validated copy-ready recipes.
